exposure: Mutations in Hh pathway genes (PTCH1, SUFU)
outcome: Decreased expression of mTOR negative regulators
cohort: PTCH1 and SUFU heterozygote cell lines and human neural stem cells were used to model disease-associated variants and investigate mechanisms.
finding: The study concludes that significant crosstalk exists between the SHH and PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathways, where mutations in PTCH1 and SUFU activate PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling by decreasing mTOR negative regulators, thus contributing to macrocephaly and overgrowth phenotypes.
